run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-14T20:27:52Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is firing because there is no Alertmanager for this Prometheus to discover. The rule loaded in the Prometheus rule file (ConfigMap prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0) is `max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1` with `for: 10m`, severity warning, so it fires when that job/namespace has zero discovered Alertmanager targets for 10 minutes. At query time the cluster contains no Alertmanager component at all: in namespace prometheus the only workloads are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, the prometheus StatefulSet and five node-exporter pods; its only services are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter; and its only Endpoints objects resolve Prometheus to 100.96.5.74:9090 and 8080. Cluster-wide, none of the 66 pods, 52 services, 6 StatefulSets or 36 Deployments returned is an Alertmanager, and no service exposes the Alertmanager port 9093 except the otel-demo kafka broker. Kubernetes endpoint-based Alertmanager discovery in namespace prometheus therefore has nothing to keep, which matches the rule's zero-discovery condition. I could not read the Prometheus gauge or its config directly, so the cluster-side absence is the supported proximate reason and the configuration-side cause remains partially unverified.

claims.text: The alert rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers is present in ConfigMap prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 with expr `max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1`, `for: 10m` and label severity: warning, so it fires when zero Alertmanager targets are discovered for that job/namespace over the last 5 minutes for at least 10 minutes.

In namespace prometheus at query time the only pods are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and five prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter-* pods, and the only StatefulSet is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (1 desired, 1 ready); no Alertmanager pod or StatefulSet exists in that namespace.

Namespace prometheus has five services (prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator 443, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus 9090/8080, prometheus-kube-state-metrics 8080, prometheus-operated 9090, prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter 9100) and five matching Endpoints objects; there is no alertmanager-operated service or endpoint, and prometheus-operated / prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus both resolve only to Prometheus itself at 100.96.5.74:9090.

Cluster-wide inventories contain no Alertmanager: 66 pods (none named alertmanager*), 52 services (only otel-demo kafka exposes port 9093, its broker port; no Alertmanager UI/API service), 6 StatefulSets (chi-clickhouse-main-0-0, jaeger-traces-recorder, prometheus-alert-recorder, topology-monitor, opensearch-cluster-master, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus) and 36 Deployments (none alertmanager).

Namespace prometheus holds only two ConfigMaps, kube-root-ca.crt and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0; no Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap exists there (Alertmanager configuration is normally kept in a Secret, which cannot be read).

The Prometheus pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running with both containers ready, restartCount 0 and no lastState, created 2026-11-14T20:27:20Z (containers started 20:27:21Z), owned by StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus; that StatefulSet was created 2026-11-13T21:13:52Z with generation 1 and currentRevision = updateRevision = prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59, so the pod was recreated without any StatefulSet template change.

The Prometheus StatefulSet uses emptyDir volumes for config-out and for prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-db and declares neither volumeClaimTemplates nor PVC volumes, so the recreated Prometheus pod starts with an empty local TSDB (storage retention flag is --storage.tsdb.retention.time=10d).

No node-level event explains the Prometheus pod recreation: all five nodes report Ready=True with no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure, the node hosting the pod (i-0bc0544469bfef13a) is Ready, and other long-running pods on that same node, including prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter-7h668, still date from 2026-11-13T21:13:51Z with 0 restarts.

The Prometheus pod itself shows no failure signature: it is Running and Ready, restartCount 0, both containers in state running, init container completed with exitCode 0, and the monitoring-stack controllers prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator and prometheus-kube-state-metrics are Ready 1/1 with their pods Running, so a crashed Prometheus pod or a dead operator/pod does not explain the alert.

In the Prometheus that these tools query, the container_memory_working_set_bytes series present in the incident window begin at 2026-11-14T20:32:52Z (about 64-70 series per 5m step, last sample 21:12:52Z), so this store provides no pre-20:32 data to compare the monitoring stack's behaviour before the Prometheus pod recreation.

Primary explanation: the alert condition is genuine. Prometheus discovers Alertmanager targets through Kubernetes service/endpoint discovery restricted to the Alertmanager service produced by the Alertmanager custom resource (alertmanager-operated); because no Alertmanager StatefulSet, Service or Endpoints object exists in namespace prometheus or anywhere else in the cluster, that discovery yields zero targets and prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered for job=prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, namespace=prometheus stays below 1 for the rule's 10m hold time.

The Alertmanager may never have been deployed with this kube-prometheus-stack release (alertmanager disabled / no Alertmanager custom resource), rather than having been deleted during the window; the two cannot be distinguished here because namespace prometheus has no events, cluster events only cover 20:35:12Z-21:07:58Z, and PVC state returned no items.

A configuration-side cause cannot be ruled out: if the operator did not render an alerting/alertmanagers block into the generated Prometheus configuration, discovery would be zero even if Kubernetes objects existed. The generated config is stored in a Secret (the StatefulSet's config volume source was redacted as a credential) and the operator/prometheus container logs returned no lines, so neither the alerting stanza nor reconcile errors could be inspected.

Rejected: the recreation of pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 at 2026-11-14T20:27:20Z as the cause of the firing. The StatefulSet template is unchanged (generation 1, identical current/update revision), a restart does not remove Kubernetes-discovered Alertmanager targets, and the rule requires the zero-discovery condition continuously for 10 minutes, which is longer than the ~10 minutes between the alert start 20:27:52Z minus 10m and the pod's creation; the restart therefore explains no more than the alert's state reset.

gaps: The monitoring.coreos.com custom resources (Alertmanager and Prometheus) are not among the readable object kinds, so it is unknown whether an Alertmanager custom resource exists in namespace prometheus, whether the Prometheus custom resource still declares alerting.alertmanagers, or whether the release was installed with Alertmanager disabled.

The generated Prometheus configuration lives in a Secret (referenced by the StatefulSet config volume, redacted as a credential) and cannot be read, so the alerting/alertmanagers stanza that Kubernetes endpoint discovery would use was not verified.

The queried Prometheus holds no prometheus_* self-metrics and no kube-state-metrics kube_* series: queries for the rule's metric via get_metric_names patterns, `up`, `ALERTS{alertname="PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers"}`, `kube_pod_info{namespace="prometheus"}` and `kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="prometheus"}` all returned no data. The value of prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is therefore unknown, not zero, and the rule's actual evaluation could not be replayed.

Container logs could not be read: fetch_pod_logs for prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 (containers prometheus, config-reloader, init-config-reloader) and for the operator pod returned 0 lines / 0 bytes for 20:20-21:17Z, so notification errors, config reload failures and reconcile errors are unknown.

Kubernetes events provide no history for this namespace: the events query in namespace prometheus returned no items, and cluster-wide events only span 2026-11-14T20:35:12Z-21:07:58Z (92 events). Whether an Alertmanager workload existed earlier and was removed during the window cannot be established.

PVC queries returned no items for namespace prometheus and none matching alertmanager cluster-wide (no_data views), so it is unknown whether Alertmanager storage existed or is retained, which would have hinted at a prior deployment.

Timing inconsistency is unresolved: the rule needs the condition since about 20:17:52Z (for: 10m, alert start 20:27:52Z from the alert context), while the current Prometheus pod was created 20:27:20Z; and the alert payload itself is the only evidence of delivery to an Alertmanager, which is hard to reconcile with zero connected Alertmanagers. Whether the alert was evaluated/forwarded by a Prometheus or alerting path outside the visible cluster objects is unknown.

The restart of pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 at 20:27:20Z is a change in the window whose cause is unknown: no event, no StatefulSet template change, no node condition and no other pod restart on node i-0bc0544469bfef13a accompany it, and its relation to the alert (if any) is not established.
next_steps: Inspect the Alertmanager custom resource in namespace prometheus (e.g. `kubectl get alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com -n prometheus`) and the Prometheus custom resource's `spec.alerting.alertmanagers` to confirm whether an Alertmanager is expected and how it is referenced (namespace/service selectors).

Read the running Prometheus configuration and its own endpoints: `GET /api/v1/status/config` and `GET /api/v1/alertmanagers` on prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, plus the prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered and prometheus_notifications_errors_total series from its /metrics.

Read the prometheus and config-reloader container logs of pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and the prometheus-operator logs around 2026-11-14T20:17Z-20:28Z for config reload and Alertmanager discovery messages.

If an Alertmanager is intended, restore the Alertmanager StatefulSet, its alertmanager-operated Service, config Secret and RBAC, then verify that prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered for job=prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, namespace=prometheus returns >= 1 and that the alert clears.
Persist Prometheus TSDB on a PVC instead of emptyDir so that a pod recreation no longer destroys alerting/notification history needed for this kind of investigation.

content:
PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
